messages:
deploy-bot: Manual approval requested for PRODUCTION deploy
Environment: production
Release: v3.8.1-rc4 (tag: r3.8.1-20260320)
Commit: 9f3b2c4
Initiated by: release-manager
Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC -> 23:00 UTC
Checks: smoke ✅, integration ✅, canary pending
Required approvers: @alex @priya
Build: <https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9f3b2c4|9f3b2c4>
Notes: includes quant patch for memory/perf. Rollback command: `./deploy rollback r3.8.0`
Approve with `/approve deploy 1912345678` or react :white_check_mark:

release-manager: Canary started on 2 nodes (canary-1, canary-2). Observability will report in ~10m. tagging as "manual-holdpoint" for audit.

ops-oncall: Quick metrics snapshot (t+5m): p95=180ms, p99=410ms, error_rate=0.04% (baseline 0.03%). No 5xx spikes. Logging looks clean from canary pods.

priya: Request — can we pin quant profile to `q8_2` for this rollout? The auto profile created small quality drift in perf tests last week. If pinning needs a re-build, say now.

alex: We can pin without rebuilding, it's a runtime config change. I'll update the release config (replacing `quant:auto` -> `quant:q8_2`) and push.

alex: /approve deploy 1912345678  // updated config pushed

deploy-bot: Approval recorded from alex. Approvals: alex ✅, priya ❌. Waiting on remaining approver(s).

priya: Confirming after pin checked — looks good to me. approving. :white_check_mark:

priya: /approve deploy 1912345678

deploy-bot: Manual approvals satisfied (2/2). Commencing rollout to production (rolling update, 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

jen: Note: rollback smoke commands below if we need to abort quickly:
```
# rollback to last stable
./deploy rollback r3.8.0 --region us-west-2 --force
kubectl rollout undo deploy/redwood-inference --namespace=prod
```

ops-oncall: Canary phase complete (t+20m): latency stable, error_rate steady at 0.03%. Moving to 50% traffic now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete — SUCCESS.
Commit: 9f3b2c4 promoted to prod. Tag r3.8.1 created.
Summary: canary: pass ✅, metrics: within SLOs ✅, no manual aborts.

release-manager: Nice work team. I'll record this in release notes and close the change window. :tada:

alex: added notes about quant pin and perf diff to the changelog.
